findings.mechanism: Root1 shared metadata helper finishes its current PRL flag check. While processing root2, its same helper performs code/material hash and complete evidence reads before checking only root2 PRL events. A controlled material callback at that stage could change owned root1 PRL flags with unchanged bytes. Root3 helper and final summary read do not revisit root1 metadata. This is the established controlled late-metadata model, not a claim to defend against arbitrary hostile same-user writers.
